result.question: How did Zebul describe the men?

readings.answer: As the shadows of the mountains
readings.support: The shadows of the mountains look like men to you

assessments.reason: Zebul says, “The shadows of the mountains look like men to you,” which matches describing them as shadows of the hills; mountains/hills are equivalent here.

result.reason: Zebul explicitly calls them “the shadows of the mountains,” which is equivalent to “shadows of the hills.”
